$\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)=3x^2+4x-4$. — B1. Factors or critical values, or substitute any 2 values $(x
e-2)$ into $\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)$ soi. — M1. Guidance: Expect $(x+2)(3x-2)$ or $-2$, $ rac23$, or any 2 substitutions excluding $x=-2$. For $-2<x< rac23$, $\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)<0$; for $x> rac23$, $\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)>0$ soi; allow $\le,\ge$. — M1. Guidance: Or at least one specific value $(
e-2)$ in each interval giving opposite signs; or $\mathrm f\,\!\prime( rac23)=0$ and $\mathrm f\,\!\prime\prime( rac23)
e0$ (i.e. gradient changes sign at $x= rac23$). Neither www. — A1. Guidance: Must have “Neither”. ALT 1: At least 3 values of $\mathrm f(x)$. — M1; e.g. $\mathrm f(0)=7$, $\mathrm f(1)=6$, $\mathrm f(2)=15$. At least 3 correct values of $\mathrm f(x)$. — A1. At least 3 correct values spanning $x= rac23$. — A1. Shows a decreasing and then increasing pattern; Neither www. — A1. Guidance: Or similar wording. Must have “Neither”. ALT 2: $\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)=3x^2+4x-4=3(x+ rac23)^2- rac{16}{3}$. — B1B1. Guidance: Do not condone sign errors. $\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)\ge- rac{16}{3}$. — M1. $\mathrm f\,\!\prime(x)<0$ for some values and $>0$ for other values; Neither www. — A1. Guidance: Or similar wording. Must have “Neither”. Total 4.
